subject: Proposal: blended routing & step-up pricing for Q3 renewal
messages:
From: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@parcelai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: ParcelAI Procurement <procurement@parcelai.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Q3 renewal — volume & budget overview

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful to walk through the renewal timing and the step-up profile we expect in Q3. Quick recap from our side and the numbers procurement asked me to confirm so your team can draft a formal proposal: 

- Current baseline: ~18M tokens/month (combined input+output) across chat and single-turn generation.
- Expected step-up: plan to ramp to ~35M by July and ~60M by November if performance/price match our targets.
- Routes to add during renewal: dense embeddings (for semantic search) and a dedicated high-throughput chat route for customer-facing assistants.
- Target unit economics: ParcelAI is aiming for ~$550–700 per 1M tokens blended across routes for the first year; procurement prefers a target around $600/1M as a negotiating anchor.
- Budget band: we have a committed budget of $80k–$110k/month for inference, approximate depending on final blended rates and any savings from caching/quantization.

Procurement also asked for a few items in the initial proposal: a simple blended-rate model by token bands, a clear definition of what counts toward billable tokens, and any notes about caching/kv savings. If you can include an example month showing cost at 18M, 35M, and 60M tokens that will help speed internal sign-off.

Next steps from our side: I'll introduce procurement on a follow-up once we see Redwood's sketch. Ideal timing — we want a signed renewal by end of April to lock Q3 pricing and capacity.

Thanks,
Ruth
Ruth Chang
Head of ML Ops, ParcelAI
ruth.chang@parcelai.com

--
Attachment: parcelai_requirements_summary.pdf (stub)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@parcelai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Q3 renewal — volume & budget overview

Ruth — thanks for the clear summary, that helps a lot. Attaching a quick sketch (parcelai_pricing_sketch.xlsx) with the blended-rate approach we discussed. A few clarifying questions so the formal proposal matches ParcelAI's expectations: 

1) Route split: can you approximate the percentage split across (a) production chat/generation, (b) embeddings, (c) internal batch jobs? If embeddings will be >20% of tokens that materially changes the blended mix.
2) Billing definition: do you want us to treat KV cache hits as billable tokens or apply an explicit credit? We can model both ways.
3) Start date for step-up: do you need the higher capacity live by July 1 or is a staged ramp acceptable (e.g., 35M live in July, full 60M in November)?

Preliminary proposal notes in the sketch:
- We show three tiers and a blended example line item.
- We assume tokens = input + output. If ParcelAI wants to exclude internal annotation/batch-only tokens, call that out.

Next steps: Ben and I will finalize a formal blended-rate table and a short SOW draft once we get your route split and confirmation on billing definition. We aim to get a proposal to you by Tue 2027-03-29.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

--
Attachment: parcelai_pricing_sketch.xlsx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Chang <ruth.chang@parcelai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pricing sketch — proposed blended bands and calc

Forwarding our internal calc and proposed bands so ParcelAI can see a concrete example. Key pieces:

- Proposed tiered unit prices (per 1M tokens, input+output):
  * Tier A (0–10M additional): $650/1M
  * Tier B (10M–50M additional): $520/1M
  * Tier C (>50M additional): $420/1M

- Blended example (applying to 60M total): we show blended ~$500/1M when splitting routes 70% chat, 20% embeddings, 10% batch.
- Embeddings route: priced separately in calculation because of different usage patterns — we used a 0.8x multiplier versus chat generation for dense vector calls.
- Assumptions: tokens billed = input + output; we included a placeholder line for caching credits (suggested discount up to 10% if average cache hit >40%).

Laura and Karthik flagged capacity commitments and a 60-day notice for tier changes; we can be flexible on minimums for the first quarter of the contract.

Attaching: redwood_blend_calc.pdf (shows per-route line items and monthly cost tables for 18M/35M/60M).

Ruth — if this looks directionally aligned I'll turn this into formal pricing language and an SOW. Also cc'd procurement alias so billing/legal have the doc for review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Pricing sketch — proposed blended bands and calc

Vanessa/Ben — appreciate the quick turn. The proposed bands look reasonable and the blended example is exactly what procurement wanted to see. A few asks before we escalate to legal for an SOW/PO: 

- Please include a one-line definition of billable tokens and an example with a small cached response (so procurement can see the net impact).
- Add a DocuSign-ready SOW stub and indicate the desired SLA for the dedicated chat route (p50/p95 latency targets + uptime commitment).
- Can you show a delta row with the budget band we provided ($80k–$110k/month) so we can confirm how short/long of the band the proposed pricing gets us?

I've looped procurement on this thread (procurement@parcelai.com). They're ready to review the SOW and sign if the DocuSign package looks good. We are aiming to finalize pricing and PO in April.

I'll stand by for the SOW + DocuSign link.

Best,
Ruth
Ruth Chang
Head of ML Ops, ParcelAI
